concept: Use case ui-mockup. Design ONE polished 16:9 settings menu mockup for the cozy fantasy game Little Red Panda's Shop, faithfully matching supplied established foliage inventory UI style. Reference establishes dark forest green fine leather/paper, aged thin bronze-gold borders, subtle realistic olive leaf sprigs, warm cream parchment and elegant readable Chinese serif typography. Background softly dimmed warm isometric fantasy shop, modal centered occupying about 70% width and 76% height, comfortable generous but not empty spacing, crisp front-facing 2D interface. Header small gold leaf sprig + Chinese title 设置, compact X close button upper right. No sidebar, no currency, no player HUD, no fake audio/video settings. Main body two organized sections: top compact dark green language row labelled 界面语言, right side segmented choices 简体中文 (selected gold border) and English (unselected). Under it a large pale parchment inset with title 操作指南 and fine botanical corner engraving. Six controls organized as a clean 2-column by 3-row grid with distinct dark green bronze-trim keycap chips and ink labels: W/A/S/D 移动 ; F 互动 ; 滚轮 缩放 ; B 背包 ; J 订单 ; R 装修. Use small separate keycaps for W A S D arranged compactly. Footer small quiet caption 语言切换立即生效 and one centered dark green gold-edged main button 返回游戏 with a small leaf icon; small Esc hint beside button. Strong typography hierarchy, centered alignment and consistent spacing. Leaf ornaments only at outer top-left and bottom-right, never obscuring controls or text. Premium handcrafted restrained fantasy UI, not ornate baroque, no huge black blank region. Render beautiful complete UI concept, not a sheet of pieces.
controls_parchment: Use case precise-object-edit. The attached settings concept is a STYLE reference. Generate just ONE isolated blank horizontal parchment content panel matching its large cream controls area. Front-facing perfectly flat 2D game UI sprite, width to height about 2:1, centered with ample transparent outer margin. Warm ivory fine parchment, restrained thin aged bronze/ink inset border, delicate olive botanical engraving only at top-left and bottom-right corners, very small leaves at other corners. Broad uniform quiet empty center suitable for text and rows. All decoration contained inside parchment edges. No green outer settings frame, no text, no numbers, no buttons, no icons, no row lines, no background scene, no perspective, no curled paper, no cast shadow outside asset, no colored matte or checkerboard baked in. Genuine transparent RGBA background outside the panel. High quality elegant foliage theme, not heavily distressed.
keycap: Use case precise-object-edit. Attached settings UI is STYLE reference. Generate ONLY ONE isolated EMPTY square keycap UI base matching the W/A/S/D keycap in reference. Straight front-on flat 2D game UI, symmetrical square with gently chamfered corners, thin double aged bronze-gold rim, dark forest green matte leather centre, subtle beveled edge and tiny restrained highlight. Occupies 75 percent of square canvas with even clear margin. NO letters, NO symbols, NO numbers, NO leaf decoration inside, NO words. Genuine transparent RGBA outside the keycap; no environment, no checkerboard, no diffuse halo, no scene or ground shadow. Crisp high quality reusable control icon base, central face almost uniform to support live cream keyboard text.
